announcements.title: Mid-Semester Exams Schedule Released
announcements.content: The schedule for the upcoming Mid-Semester examinations has been published. Please check the notice board outside the HOD's office or download the PDF from the college website.

announcements.title: Tech Fest 2026 Registrations Open
announcements.content: Registrations for the annual Tech Fest are now open! Form teams and register before 25th October. Exciting prizes await the winners.
